summary.text: Denise Crosswhite Hader, listed by Ballotpedia as Denise Hader, is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 41 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Denise Hader assumed office on November 21, 2018, succeeding John Enns.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Government Oversight Committee, and she was vice chair of the Administrative Rules Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
